description: The file 'MathUtils.java' contains a utility class with static methods for mathematical operations, angle normalization, hashing, sign copying, and input validation, used within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: MathUtils
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for various mathematical operations, angle normalization, and input validation.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Returns an integer hash code for a double value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two double values are semantically equal.

methods.name: hash (double array)
methods.description: Returns a hash code for a double array.

methods.name: normalizeAngle
methods.description: Normalizes an angle to be within a 2π interval around a specified center.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces a value to within a primary interval [0, |period|) based on an offset.

methods.name: copySign
methods.description: Returns a value with the magnitude of the first argument and the sign of the second argument for various numeric types.

methods.name: checkFinite
methods.description: Ensures a double or array of doubles is finite, throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Checks that an object is not null; throws NullArgumentException if it is.
